<includeonly><div class="topmenu">{{{1|-}}}</div></includeonly><noinclude>
Shows a horizontal menu (designed for only a few entries).

{{Feature | important | Links should be all on the same line to avoid unwanted {{hl|&lt;p&gt;}} tags leading to smaller anchor links mid-menu.}}

== Usage ==
{{<nowiki/>TopMenu|'''''links'''''}}
* links: Wiki links (internal or external)

{| class="wikitable"
|+ Examples

! Result

| <nowiki>{{TopMenu}}</nowiki>
| {{TopMenu}}
|-
